company.shortDescription: Legacy provides a service for at-home sperm testing and cryopreservation, allowing individuals to take control of their fertility health.
company.description: Legacy provides a service for at-home sperm testing and cryopreservation, allowing individuals to take control of their fertility health from the comfort of their homes. Their semen analysis is conducted in CLIA-certified labs, ensuring high-quality testing without the need for direct doctor involvement. As America's largest at-home fertility clinic for men, Legacy empowers clients to understand their reproductive health and plan for the future effectively.
